about.title: About Us
about.metaDescription: Discover Enouza home decor and design. Elevate your home with curated decor, designer accents, and handcrafted pieces for modern interiors.
about.intro: At Enouza, we believe home decor is more than decoration — it’s an experience.
about.passion: Our passion is creating spaces that feel warm, refined, and timeless. That’s why we carefully curate decor that combines modern design, premium materials, and exceptional craftsmanship. Every piece in our collection is chosen to elevate your home, not just fill it.
about.visionText: We aim to redefine everyday home decor by offering statement pieces that bring elegance, comfort, and character into any room. From cozy bedrooms to sophisticated living spaces, our pieces are designed to transform atmospheres.
about.qualityText: We work closely with trusted manufacturers and designers who share our commitment to quality. Each piece is selected for its durability, aesthetic value, and attention to detail — because luxury should be felt, not just seen.
about.modernText: Our collection blends contemporary trends with classic elegance, making our pieces perfect for modern homes, apartments, and luxury interiors. Whether you’re looking for a statement piece or a subtle finishing touch, Enouza brings decor that reflects your style.
about.closing: Thank you for choosing Enouza — where decor meets design.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Enouza.com (the “Site” or “we”) collects, uses, and discloses your Personal Information when you visit or make a purchase from the Site.

collectingPersonalInfo.title: Collecting Personal Information
collectingPersonalInfo.description: When you visit the Site, we collect certain information about your device, your interaction with the Site, and the information necessary to process your purchases. We may also collect additional information if you contact us for customer support. In this Privacy Policy, we refer to any information that can uniquely identify an individual (including the information below) as 'Personal Information'.

deviceInfo.title: Device Information
deviceInfo.examples: Examples of Personal Information collected: web browser version, IP address, time zone, cookie information, sites or products you view, search terms, and how you interact with the Site.
deviceInfo.purpose: Purpose of collection: to load the Site accurately for you and to perform analytics on Site usage to optimize our Site.
deviceInfo.source: Source of collection: Collected automatically when you access our Site using cookies, log files, web beacons, tags, or pixels.
deviceInfo.disclosure: Disclosure for a business purpose: shared with our processor Enouza.

orderInfo.title: Order Information
orderInfo.examples: Examples of Personal Information collected: name, billing address, shipping address, payment information, email address, and phone number.
orderInfo.purpose: Purpose of collection: to provide products or services to you, process payment information, arrange shipping, provide invoices or order confirmations, communicate with you, screen orders for risk or fraud, and provide advertising or information in line with your preferences.
orderInfo.source: Source of collection: collected from you.
orderInfo.disclosure: Disclosure for a business purpose: shared with our processor Enouza.

customerSupportInfo.title: Customer Support Information
customerSupportInfo.examples: Examples of Personal Information collected: name, billing address, shipping address, payment information, email address, and phone number.
customerSupportInfo.purpose: Purpose of collection: to provide customer support.
customerSupportInfo.source: Source of collection: collected from you.

sharingPersonalInfo.title: Sharing Personal Information
sharingPersonalInfo.text: We share your Personal Information with service providers to help us provide our services and fulfill our contracts with you, as described above. For example, we may share your Personal Information to comply with applicable laws and regulations, respond to subpoenas, search warrants, or other lawful requests, or to otherwise protect our rights.

behavioralAdvertising.title: Behavioral Advertising
behavioralAdvertising.text: We use your Personal Information to provide you with targeted advertisements or marketing communications we believe may be of interest to you. For example, we use Google Analytics to understand how customers use the Site. More about Google's use of Personal Information: https://policies.google.com/privacy. Opt-out: https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout. We also share information about your use of the Site and ads with advertising partners.

usingPersonalInfo.title: Using Personal Information
usingPersonalInfo.text: We use your Personal Information to provide our services, including offering products for sale, processing payments, shipping and fulfilling orders, and keeping you updated on new products, services, and offers.

lawfulBasis.title: Lawful Basis
lawfulBasis.text: If you are a resident of the EEA, we process your personal information under the following lawful bases: your consent, performance of a contract, legal obligations, vital interests, public interest tasks, or legitimate interests not overriding your fundamental rights.

retention.title: Retention
retention.text: When you place an order through the Site, we retain your Personal Information unless and until you ask us to erase it.

automaticDecisionMaking.title: Automatic Decision-Making
automaticDecisionMaking.text: If you are an EEA resident, you have the right to object to automated decision-making (including profiling) with legal or significant effect. Our processor uses limited automated decisions to prevent fraud, such as temporary deny lists for IPs or credit cards.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.gdpr: EEA residents have the right to access, port, correct, update, or erase their Personal Information. Contact us to exercise these rights.
yourRights.ccpa: California residents have the right to access ('Right to Know'), port, correct, update, or erase their Personal Information. You may designate an authorized agent to submit requests.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: Cookies are small pieces of information downloaded to your device when visiting our Site. We use functional, performance, advertising, and social media cookies to enhance your browsing experience and remember preferences.

doNotTrack.title: Do Not Track
doNotTrack.text: Since there is no consistent industry response to 'Do Not Track' signals, we do not alter our data collection practices if such a signal is detected in your browser.

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in practices or for legal, regulatory, or operational reasons.

contact.title: Contact

returns.heading: Returns:
returns.text: Simply put, you can return merchandise for a refund ONLY if the item is in BRAND NEW, UNOPENED CONDITION, including its original packaging and accessories. We know this seems a little extreme, but without this stipulation, we would not be able to offer our amazing prices. We will honor refunds for unopened items up until 15 - 25 days from when you have received your product. All refunds will be issued back to your original payment method and can take up to 7-10 business days to apply.

rejectedRefunds.heading: Your refund will be rejected if your items are returned due to the following issues:
items: If you want to return your product due to damage to the item’s original box.
If the product you returned has been opened and unsealed.
Items with minor cosmetic paint problems for prize figures as these are expected.

exceptions.heading: Exceptions / Non-Returnable items:
exceptions.text: Pre-orders are final sales and are non-returnable once shipped. If you receive a defective product, please contact us for information on contacting the manufacturer. Items with box imperfections and general flaws. Please contact us if you have questions or concerns about your specific item.

returnShipping.heading: Return Shipping:
returnShipping.text: To return a product, please contact our customer support with your order number and reason for return. You will be provided with a return label if your return request is approved.

damagesIssues.heading: Damages and Issues
damagesIssues.text: Please inspect your order upon reception and contact us immediately if the item is defective, damaged, or if you received the wrong item so that we can evaluate the issue and make it right.

refunds.heading: Refunds
refunds.text: We will notify you once we’ve received and inspected your return, and let you know if the refund was approved. If approved, you’ll be automatically refunded on your original payment method. Please remember it can take some time for your bank or credit card company to process and post the refund.

paragraphe: Yes! We're delighted to offer free shipping on selected products and eligible destinations. We believe shopping for something special should be simple, convenient, and transparent.
Shipping costs may vary depending on your destination and the products in your order. Here's an overview of our international shipping rates:
list: Australia: $0.00 – $43.99
Other international destinations: Free shipping available on selected products.
Your final shipping cost will always be displayed at checkout before you complete your purchase.

shippingFaq.question: What happens if my package is lost or doesn't arrive?

paragraphe: Your order is important to us, and we're here to help if something doesn't go as planned.

If your tracking information shows that your package has been delivered but you haven't received it, please check with your local carrier and contact our Customer Support Team within 30 days of the reported delivery date.
If the carrier confirms that your package was lost due to a delivery error, we'll help arrange an appropriate solution, including a replacement or refund where applicable.
Please double-check your shipping address before completing your order. Incorrect or incomplete addresses may result in delivery delays or additional shipping charges.
If you notice an error in your delivery details, contact us as soon as possible with your order number and the correct address. We'll do our best to update your information before dispatch.
We know you're excited to receive your order! That's why we work hard to prepare and ship every purchase as quickly as possible.
Orders are typically processed within 1–3 business days (Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays).
Once dispatched, standard delivery usually takes 5–10 business days, depending on your location and product availability.
The total estimated timeframe is approximately 6–13 business days from the date your order is placed.
You'll receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking information as soon as your order is on its way, whenever tracking is available.
Please note that delivery times are estimates and may vary due to customs clearance, local carriers, public holidays, or unexpected shipping delays.

shippingFaq.question: Will my order arrive in one package?

paragraphe: We work with different fulfillment locations to bring you a carefully curated selection of products.
If your order contains items shipped from different warehouses, they may arrive in separate packages and on different dates.
Don't worry! You won't be charged additional shipping fees beyond the amount confirmed at checkout simply because your order arrives in multiple shipments.
We believe in clear and transparent pricing, so you'll always know what to expect before placing your order.

Simply add your favorite products to your cart and proceed to checkout. Once you enter your delivery address, any applicable shipping fees will be calculated based on your destination and order details.
If your products and destination qualify for free shipping, the shipping charge will be displayed as $0.00.
You'll have the opportunity to review your complete order total, including any shipping charges, before confirming your purchase.
We want you to shop with complete confidence. If an eligible order is canceled or a return is approved, our team will help make the refund process as straightforward as possible.
Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method, and you'll receive an email confirmation once your refund has been processed.
list: Refunds are generally processed within 1–5 business days after your return has been received and approved.
PayPal refunds typically appear within 3–5 business days after processing.
Refunds to other payment methods may take approximately 3–10 business days, depending on your payment provider.
Orders that haven't entered shipment processing may be eligible for cancellation and a prompt refund.
If your order has already been dispatched, a return may be required before a refund can be issued.
Our Customer Support Team is always available to guide you through the process.

paragraphe: Shop with confidence! We want you to love every purchase from Enouza. If something isn't quite right, we're here to help make the return process simple and straightforward.

We offer a 30-day return policy for eligible products. If your purchase doesn't meet your expectations, you can request a return for a refund to your original payment method, subject to our return conditions.
Once your return has been received and approved, we'll process your refund within 1–5 business days. The time it takes to appear in your account depends on your payment provider.
list: Items should be returned in their original packaging, including all accessories and components.
For change-of-mind returns, products must be unused and in their original condition, without visible signs of wear or modification.
Clearance and final-sale items may have specific return restrictions, except where required by law.
Original shipping charges are generally non-refundable for voluntary returns.
Return shipping costs are generally the customer's responsibility for change-of-mind returns.
If you receive an incorrect, damaged, or defective product, please contact us so we can arrange an appropriate solution.
Your statutory consumer rights remain unaffected by this policy.

returnFaq.question: How do I return a product?

paragraphe: Need to return something? No worries! Our Customer Support Team is here to make the process as easy as possible.
Simply follow these steps to request a return:
list: Contact our Customer Support Team within the applicable return period and provide your order number.
Let us know which product you'd like to return and briefly explain the reason.
Our team will review your request and provide clear return instructions.
Carefully pack the product in its original packaging, including all accessories and components.
Ship the item to the return address provided by our support team.
Once your return has been received and inspected, we'll notify you of the outcome and process any approved refund.
If your item arrived damaged, defective, or incorrect, please contact us before returning it so we can help arrange the appropriate solution.

returnFaq.question: What should I do if my order arrives damaged?

paragraphe: We're sorry if your order didn't arrive in perfect condition. We take great care in delivering a positive shopping experience, and we're committed to making things right.
If your product arrives damaged or defective, please contact our Customer Support Team as soon as possible.
Include your order number, a brief description of the issue, and clear photos of the product and packaging whenever possible.
Our team will review your request and help arrange an appropriate solution, which may include a replacement, repair, or partial or full refund, depending on the circumstances.
Your satisfaction matters to us, and we'll work to resolve the issue as smoothly as possible.

returnFaq.question: Are there any products that cannot be returned?

paragraphe: Most eligible products can be returned within our return period. However, certain items may have specific return conditions for hygiene, safety, or other reasons.
Where applicable, product-specific return restrictions will be clearly indicated on the relevant product page.
list: Products marked as final sale or clearance may be excluded from voluntary returns, except where required by law.
Items that have been used, damaged after delivery, installed, or modified may not qualify for a change-of-mind return.
Certain hygiene-sensitive or personal-use products may not be eligible for return once opened or unsealed, where permitted by applicable law.
Customized or personalized products may have specific return restrictions.
Products returned without their original accessories or essential components may require additional review.
Damaged, defective, or incorrectly supplied products are handled separately in accordance with applicable consumer protection laws.
If you're unsure whether a product is eligible for return, our Customer Support Team will be happy to assist you.

returnFaq.question: What if my product is defective or has missing parts?

paragraphe: We want every product you receive to meet your expectations. If something is missing or isn't working as it should, we're here to help.
Please contact our Customer Support Team with your order number, a description of the issue, and photos or a short video whenever possible.

Our team will review your request and help arrange an appropriate solution, such as replacement parts, a replacement product, repair, or refund, depending on the circumstances and applicable consumer rights.
We recommend keeping the original packaging and included accessories until the issue has been resolved.

returnFaq.question: When will I receive my refund?

paragraphe: Once your eligible return has been received and approved, we'll begin processing your refund as quickly as possible.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method, and we'll notify you by email once your refund has been processed.
list: Refund processing typically takes 1–5 business days after return approval.
PayPal refunds generally appear within 3–5 business days after processing.
Other payment methods may take approximately 3–10 business days, depending on your bank or payment provider.
Eligible orders canceled before shipment processing may be refunded without requiring a return.
Orders already dispatched may need to be returned before a refund is issued.
If your refund hasn't appeared after the expected processing period, please contact our Customer Support Team for assistance.
